g.text: Three coefficients exclude both remaining complex points

g.text: The full correction matrix has rank 742; adjoining the target raises the rank to 743.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53666d

g.text: Its 777 columns include 462 unrestricted quotient terms and all 315 shared Koszul correction directions.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #166a70

g.text: Both degree-six candidates are excluded by exact arithmetic. Combined with the preceding reductions, the complete mixed-biweight degree-six family is excluded.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53666d

g.text: The complex-point coordinates are drawn approximately, but the field arithmetic and every functional pairing use rational coefficients exactly.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53666d

g.text: Higher degrees remain open. This is an obstruction, not a certificate of existence, Lean proof, or accepted solution.
